spans.s: ऐतिशायन, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.

ऐतिहासिक ऐतिहासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इति-
हास), derived from ancient legends, legendary,
historical, traditional; (अस्), m. one who relates or
knows ancient legends, an historian.

ऐतिह्य ऐतिह्य, अम्, n. (fr. इति-ह; see under
इति, p. 139), traditional instruction.
